environment.host: Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19045 workstation, Intel Core i7-4790 (4 cores / 8 threads, 3.6 GHz), 31.9 GB RAM; client and server on the same host
environment.backend: uvicorn single process, isolated port 8191, ASP_MODEL_STUDIO_RUNTIME_ROOT + ATLAS_SQLITE_PATH + ATLAS_SECURITY_DB_PATH + staging roots pointed at disposable copies under the scratch directory; primary services (8101/5274) never started
environment.client: python httpx (one client per synthetic user, timeout 300 s in the load phases, 900 s in the patient phase); curl for idle health checks
environment.population: 103 synthetic users (fable51-admin/user-a/user-b + f51-load-000..099) created through the admin API on the disposable security DB; 100 synthetic projects with evidence binding + forecast contract; job phases use the disposable copy of asp-mtddc6pw (the only Model-Lab-executable project, F-003)
environment.note: All fits are synthetic audit activity on the disposable copy: class_frequency_null and multinomial_logistic FIXED on a 6-feature CUSTOM_SUBSET; no final-OOT row, no champion, no promotion; deleted with the scratch root

registration100.result: 100 users created via POST /admin/users; an earlier warm-up run produced HTTP 500/401 during bulk creation because the security DB (rollback-journal mode) was locked by concurrent session writes (F-028)

login100.note: PBKDF2-SHA256 260k iterations per login is CPU-bound: ~5 logins/s on this host

projectSetup100.ops: create project + evidence binding + forecast contract

interactive25.design: 25 concurrent synthetic users, each looping over list_projects, open_project, eda_metadata, eda_overview, eda_distribution, autosave_put, outlier_summary, feature_summary, split_contracts, stage2_review on its own project for a 90 s target window
interactive25.errorsDetail: all 13 errors are client timeouts (300 s) on outlier_summary; the server kept computing those profiles after the clients gave up

jobUnderResidualLoad.job: stage3-model-job-642e4813759e4ea48635c4dc75e8ab5b (null + logistic FIXED, 10 fits) submitted 2026-09-05T17:02:58Z while the outlier profiles left over from interactive25 were still computing

coordinatorKillAndRecovery.killedAt: ~2026-09-05T13:09:08-04:00 with the job RUNNING (one candidate receipt already persisted)
coordinatorKillAndRecovery.orphanReconciliation: run_records status INTERRUPTED, error MODEL_DEVELOPMENT_COORDINATOR_INTERRUPTED, completed_at 2026-09-05T17:09:44Z (first read after restart); the completed null-model receipt was retained, the in-flight logistic fit was lost

simultaneousIdenticalSubmissions.note: identical plan submissions coalesce onto one job

cancelUnstarted.requestedAtFits: 8 of 10 complete, configuration 2 of 2 already started

progress.message: Immutable development evidence persisted; no model was promoted.

cancelUnstarted.interpretation: cancel-unstarted is configuration-granular; a configuration that has started always runs all of its folds; no API stops a running configuration

idleReference.note: curl idle health is ~4 ms; the ~0.4 s httpx health figures include per-call client connection setup on Windows and are comparable only with each other

registeredUsers.basis: 100 accounts created and logged in without functional failure; account storage is not the constraint. Concurrent registration/login is: ~5 logins/s (PBKDF2) and security-DB lock errors during bulk writes (F-028)

concurrentInteractiveUsers.basis: 25 concurrent -> 0.3 req/s, p50 9.7 s, p95 300 s, 13 timeouts, 7.0 GB RSS, 2.8 cores; list_projects alone costs ~55 ms per project (6.2 s idle at 113 projects, 53 s under load)

simultaneousHeavyJobs.basis: one in-process ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) slot; one active job per project (409 otherwise); a second heavy job cannot run at all. One running job raised idle list_projects from 6.2 s to 8.1 s and kept health at ~0.4 s (httpx)

derivedLimits.sustainableEnvelope: 1 heavy job + 2 interactive scientists on distinct projects on this host
derivedLimits.jobCancellation: configuration-granular, unbounded time-to-abort (equal to the remaining duration of the started configuration); process kill is the only abort and yields INTERRUPTED with completed receipts retained
derivedLimits.restartBehaviour: automatic orphan reconciliation on first read; no resume; interprocess lock reclaimable; new job accepted within seconds of restart
derivedLimits.memory: outlier/EDA profiles load the full 683,662-row Gold frame per project and are retained by process caches; 25 users drove RSS to 7.0 GB; a 16 GB host would exhaust memory near 10 concurrent profiles

tier2_controlled_beta.status: PROJECTED_ONLY: requires worker separation, queue, PostgreSQL, per-request profile caching by content digest, project-list pagination; not measurable on the current build
